options.name: accept_eula
options.description: Required to indicate your acceptance of the End User License Agreement when creating this cluster. To accept the EULA, set this parameter to true.

options.name: attributes
options.description: List of name-value pairs in JSON object format.

options.name: cluster_admin_password
options.description: Initial password for the cluster admin account. If not provided, default to password.

options.name: cluster_admin_username
options.description: Username for the cluster admin. If not provided, default to username.

options.name: encryption
options.description: to enable or disable encryption at rest

options.name: fail_if_cluster_already_exists_with_larger_ensemble
options.displayName: Fail If Cluster Already Exists With Larger Ensemble
options.description: If the cluster exists, the default is to verify that I(nodes) is a superset of the existing ensemble. A superset is accepted because some nodes may have a different role. But the module reports an error if the existing ensemble contains a node not listed in I(nodes). This checker is disabled when this option is set to false.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: management_virtual_ip
options.description: Floating (virtual) IP address for the cluster on the management network.

options.name: nodes
options.description: Storage IP (SIP) addresses of the initial set of nodes making up the cluster. nodes IP must be in the list.

options.name: order_number
options.description: (experimental) order number as provided by NetApp

options.name: replica_count
options.description: Number of replicas of each piece of data to store in the cluster.

options.name: serial_number
options.description: (experimental) serial number as provided by NetApp

options.name: storage_virtual_ip
options.description: Floating (virtual) IP address for the cluster on the storage (iSCSI) network.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to wait for cluster creation to complete.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
